description: Save one durable topic as a new record in the selected Vault. Requires create permission. Recall the topic first: when a related record exists, update it with ragionex_update_memory instead of saving a copy. Content is English. The priority rule in the user's agent rules file defines save and update behavior.

content.description: English content for one durable topic, written so a reader in a fresh session understands it. Keep related details together; split facts that can change independently into separate saves, one call each.

name: ragionex_save_memory
title: Save a memory
